name: FFS_RESOURCE_TYPE
description: Contains a complete list of resource types registered in the system.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: It is an unique ID of the type.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: It is a text label of the type. The provider type labels are unique inside of the same company.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: It is a status of the type. The status controls an ability to select this type in GUI for a new object.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: It is a bitmask field that defines active features for this provider type.

columns.name: ROLE
columns.description: Role of the resource. Affects resource types features.

columns.name: ICONS
columns.description: It is a reference to a set of icons to be used to represent providers of this type in GUI.

columns.name: LOAD_DETERMINATION_METHOD
columns.description: These parameters are used to determine and represent a level of load for providers of this type in GUI.

columns.name: UNDERLOAD_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Quantity of activities in the route equals to or less than value.

columns.name: OVERLOAD_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Quantity of activities in the route equals to or greater than value.

columns.name: WORKING_HOURS_COST
columns.description: It defines an average cost of one minute of technician's time during regular working hours.

columns.name: TRAVEL_COST
columns.description: It defines a balance between cost of travel time and cost of work duration. (percents, (0; 100)).

columns.name: OVERTIME_SOFT_COST
columns.description: It defines an increase of technician's time cost for overtime. (percents).

columns.name: OVERTIME_LIMIT
columns.description: It defines a limit for overtime that is used to add additional cost. (percents).

columns.name: OVERTIME_HARD_COST
columns.description: It defines an increase of technician's time cost for overtime exceeding the limit. (percents).

columns.name: GPS_TRACK_INACTIVE
columns.description: Mobile interfaces: It defines if GPS coordinates should be collected for a resource when route of this resource is inactive.

columns.name: GPS_HIGH_PRECISION
columns.description: Mobile interfaces: It defines if a high accuracy method should be used to retrieve GPS coordinates.

columns.name: GPS_FREQUENCY_WORKING
columns.description: Defines a frequency of sending coordinates from browser. Value in minutes.

columns.name: GPS_FREQUENCY_IDLE
columns.description: Defines a frequency of sending coordinates from browser when user has not a started activity. Value in minutes.

columns.name: USE_PERSONAL_PROFILE_FOR_CALC
columns.description: If set, this provider type is used for activity duration calculation.

columns.name: DURATION_AFFECTS_AVG
columns.description: If set, Reported duration data affects company average.

columns.name: SKIP_DAYS_FOR_STATS
columns.description: Skip first n days for learning statistics.

columns.name: UNPAID_START_TRAVEL
columns.description: Unpaid part travel from start provider location - minutes.

columns.name: UNPAID_FINAL_TRAVEL
columns.description: Unpaid part travel to final provider location - minutes.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
